description.value: Yoko Sushi & Noodle is a Japanese restaurant in Surrey's Fraser Valley serving sushi and noodle dishes. Located in a strip-mall unit on 56 Ave, it offers dine-in and online ordering. Touring cyclists passing through Surrey's suburban corridors will find it a convenient lunch or dinner stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating Japanese restaurant at #103 - 15153 56 Ave, Surrey, with a current promotional offer and listed business hours. The website provides address and phone not present in OSM, and the business name on the website ('Yoko Sushi & Noodle') differs from the OSM name ('Yoko Sushi'). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; online ordering is referenced, confirming takeout availability.
concerns: OSM name is 'Yoko Sushi' but website identifies the business as 'Yoko Sushi & Noodle' — OSM record may be truncated.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with confirmed address, phone, and active online ordering. Useful to touring cyclists as a meal stop in Surrey.
